berry_yield_note: Berries per plant (Tyler card berries-per-plant, 2026-10-23; Dave may change): one E on a ripe plant gives all of item x count and leaves the plant bare until the next season. Keyed by flora name (data/tables/flora.json). The server gather() berry branch reads this (Steve).
harvest_yield_note: Harvest per plant beyond berries (Tyler card harvest-counts, 2026-10-23; Dave may change): one E on a ripe plant gives all of item x count and leaves it bare until its next season. Same shape as berry_yield; keyed by flora name. Root herbs: uprooting IS the harvest (count 2). At most 3 slots per harvest.

yield_scale.note: A plant's berry and harvest count is the table number times its size (patch scale 1 to 3, Dave 2026-10-23), never above max times the table. Uproot always gives a normal 1x plant item.

note: What gathering gives. by_species wins over by_kind; each entry is [item id, min, max]. A plant or shrub with no entry here cannot be gathered yet (food and herb items come with the gatherer, cook and potion work). Trees are felled, not gathered (tree-fall comes later).

bank.note: Pickable stones along the water's edge, in place of the drawn pebbles and boulders (Dave 2026-10-21): in a cell with water within cell_probe_m, tries spots and puts a stone on a dry one within reach_m of water with the given chance, up to max a cell.

spawn_boost.note: Campfire friction fix (coordinator 2026-10-21, Radar): within radius_m of the respawn point every cell gets extra loose things so a new player finds a campfire kit's worth (20 sticks, 10 stones) in a few minutes of walking. Elsewhere the scatter stays sparse. Server-side layout only, no bake. stones_add and sticks_add are [min, max] added to the cell's roll (stones capped at stones_max_boost, sticks at sticks_max_boost).

trunk.note: Working a felled trunk with the axe, one blow at a time: first the branches and leaves come off, then logs, with some bark and now and then seeds. The trunk is used up when its logs are gone. When the last log is gone the root ball comes up (roots). The seed roll gives the species' own fruit or nut from by_species when it has one, else a seed bundle.

tool_wear.note: Tool wear tuning (job 74). Each use of a tool adds per_use[tool class][kind of work] to its wear (1 when not listed); the tool breaks at its items.json durability and a repair gives back repair_restores of that durability for the items.json repair materials. Kinds of work: gather (a plant yield that needs the tool), rock (stone from an outcrop), tree (one blow on a standing tree), trunk (one blow on a felled trunk), split (one log at the chopping block), dig (one spade dig of the ground). Read the sheet: /mnt/project-files/items/TOOL_WEAR.md (tools/tool_wear_sheet.py rewrites it from this data).

tool_rules.note: Natural yields of a picked plant need a tool when their item id ends with one of these words (Dave 2026-10-20: roots and bulbs need a spade, bark, gum, sap and resin a stone knife, wood an axe; berries, leaves, flowers and herbs are by hand). The tool must be in the pack. Fixed drops above (fibre, sticks) are always by hand.

dig_fell.note: Digging a tree down (Dave 2026-10-21, job 85). Enough ground dug from under a standing tree makes it fall as a trunk. The support is the disc under the trunk, radius support_r_per_trunk x the species' trunk_m + support_r_base, depth_m deep; the tree falls when the share of it not dug away (fills put it back) is under fall_below: conifers (shallow roots, a species name containing one of conifer_words) 0.45, other trees 0.35, trees with a trunk_m of big_trunk_m or more 0.25. Only trees within search_m of the dig are looked at. About 4 digs bring down a spruce, 6 a beech, 11 an oak. Set fall_below to 0 to switch it off.
